**RIPPLE** is a co-op VR horror game set in flooded poolrooms, for Meta Quest. This is a free demo build.

### Install on a Quest
1. In the Meta Horizon phone app, open your headset's settings and turn on **Developer mode** (needs a free Meta developer account).
2. Download `RIPPLE-demo-{VERSION}.apk` below.
3. Install it with [SideQuest](https://sidequestvr.com/) (drag the APK onto it), or with `adb install RIPPLE-demo-{VERSION}.apk`.
4. On the headset, open it from **Library**, under **Unknown sources**.

If installing over an older RIPPLE build fails, uninstall the old one first.

### Playing together
Everyone needs to be on the same Wi-Fi. One player picks **Host**; the others pick **Join** and choose the host from the list (or type the host's address).

### Credits
All models, sounds and music are by human artists under CC0 or CC BY licences. They're listed in-game (Credits) and in [ASSETS.md](https://github.com/bryanbr0thesigma-droid/RIPPLE_horror/blob/claude/admiring-ride-o5042e/ASSETS.md).
